units.source_text: 玉鬘一路上走得很慢，并且依靠种种助力。

en.t: Tamakazura walked very slowly all along the way and had to rely on various kinds of help.

units.source_text: 然而脚底已经发肿，动弹不得了。

en.t: But the soles of her feet had already swollen, and she could no longer move.

units.source_text: 万不得已，只好在椿市一处人家暂时休息。

en.t: With no other choice, they stopped for a while to rest at a house in Tsubaichi.

units.source_text: 回行者除了一家所依靠的丰后介之外，有身带弓矢的武士二人、仆役及童男三四人。

en.t: In the party returning with her, besides Bungo no Suke, on whom the household depended, there were two warriors carrying bows and arrows, along with servants and three or four boys.

units.source_text: 女眷只有玉鬘、乳母及兵部君三人。

en.t: The only women were Tamakazura, her nurse, and Hyobu no Kimi, three in all.

units.source_text: 大家把衣服披在头上，撩起衣裾，头戴女笠，作旅行装束。

en.t: They draped their robes over their heads, tucked up their hems, put on women's travel hats, and dressed themselves for the road.

units.source_text: 此外尚有司理清洁的女仆一人、老侍女二人。

en.t: Besides them, there was one maid in charge of keeping things clean and two elderly waiting women.

units.source_text: 这一行人数极少，绝不铺张。

en.t: Their party was very small and entirely without show.

units.source_text: 他们到达之后，整理佛前明灯，添补供品，不觉日色已暮。

en.t: After they arrived, they tended the lamps before the Buddha and replenished the offerings, and before they knew it the day had grown dark.

units.source_text: 这宿处的主人是个法师，从外边回来，看见玉鬘一行人等在此投宿，眉头一皱，说道：

en.t: The master of this lodging was a monk; when he came back from outside and saw Tamakazura's party staying there, he frowned and said,
"Tonight an honored guest is supposed to come and stay here.
Where did this lot come from?

units.source_text: 女人家不懂规矩，会做出不像样的事来。”

en.t: Women do not know the proper rules and will end up doing something unseemly."
Tamakazura and the others were very displeased when they heard this.

units.source_text: 正在此时，果然有一群人进来了。

en.t: Just then, sure enough, a group of people came in.
